definitions.explanation: An intense, vivid shade of red.
Describes a face that has turned red from embarrassment, anger, or heat.
In the expression {真|ま}っ{赤|か}な{嘘|うそ}, means a blatant lie.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紅葉|もみじ}→紅葉：05387_momiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{赤|か}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧。
examples.english: The autumn leaves turned bright red.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{赤|か}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{燃|も}えていた→燃える：02312_moeru⟧。
examples.english: The sky was burning bright red in the sunset.

examples.japanese: ⟦{恥|は}ずかしくて→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{赤|か}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I was so embarrassed that my face turned red.
His face turned red with anger.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}たら→出る：00513_deru⟧、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{赤|か}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: When I got out of the bath, my body was bright red.
Everything he said was a complete lie.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧{真|ま}っ{赤|か}な⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ついて→つく：noentry⟧、⟦{恥|は}ずかしく→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Aren't you ashamed of telling such a blatant lie?

notes:
Part of a series of intensified color expressions using {真|ま}っ〜.

SIMILAR INTENSIFIED COLORS:
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}→真っ白：07613_masshiro⟧ (pure white)
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{黒|くろ}→真っ黒：07614_makkuro⟧ (jet black)
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{青|さお}→真っ青：07615_massao⟧ (deep blue; pale - from shock)
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}→真っ暗：07616_makkura⟧ (pitch dark)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {真|ま}っ{赤|か}な⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧ (outright lie, blatant lie)
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{赤|か} (face is flushed/blushing)
- {真|ま}っ{赤|か}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{燃|も}える→燃える：02312_moeru⟧ (to burn bright red)
